text:
maria: Morning — planning handoff for LAX2 cluster bring-up. Preflight tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need quick smoke: GPU drivers, node-level CUDA test, kube-scheduler pod placement, NFS mounts, egress to S3, LB health checks, and SLO gate checklist before we move to handoff. Who can own driver + kernel sanity?
sasha: I can take GPU driver + kernel modules. I'll run gpustat + nvidia-smi, and verify driver version matches pinned AMI.
raj: I'll cover kube-scheduler and pod placement rules, check taints/tolerations and GPU resource isolation.
dong: I'll validate networking egress, NAT gateways, and S3 endpoints. Also confirm subnet route tables and sg rules.
alicia: I'll run the storage checks (NFS mounts + PV/PVC binding) and run a write/read test.
deploy-bot: smoke job queued: job-id 2026-lax2-smoke-01. Status: queued.
sasha: quick note — pool has 2x A100 nodes. Ops: are these preemptible or reserved?
maria: reserved for first 48h, label as dedicated-testing during smoke. Ops please ensure billing tags.
finance-bot: tagging confirmed: env=lax2-test owner=eng-infra cost-center=infra-pilot.
raj: For SLO gates — propose these pass criteria: 1) p95 latency for inference server <50ms (cold-start excluded), 2) pod restart rate <0.5% over 30m, 3) GPU util >5% when load applied, 4) network egress to S3 <200ms p95.
alicia: Agree. I'll add file IO benchmark: fio 1G sequential write/read 3 runs, target <100ms p95.
dong: I'll run curl tests to S3 endpoints and iperf between two nodes to verify intra-cluster bandwidth.
maria: Oncall please stand by at 08:30 for handoff window 09:00. @sre-oncall are you available?
sre-oncall: I'll be there. I'll also stream logs and tail kubelet/systemd on the nodes.
sasha: driver check snippet I'll run:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,gpu_uuid --format=csv
gpustat --color
```
sasha: if driver mismatch, we rollback to AMI with driver 515.76
maria: Plan for fallbacks: if any SLO fails, we abort handoff and roll cluster into 'degraded-testing' and open incident. Confirmed?
raj: Confirmed. I'll prepare a canary traffic reroute to fallback model in us-west1 if latencies spike.
alicia: I'll document PV rename and PVC bindings in the runbook before handoff.
maria: ok let's execute smoke tomorrow. Post your smoke job results in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: smoke job 2026-lax2-smoke-01 started.
sasha: smoke job finished — driver ok on node-3, node-4. gpustat shows both GPUs healthy. gpuutil during short test ~12%.
alicia: storage smoke: PVCs bound, fio seq write p95=62ms, read p95=58ms.
dong: network smoke: iperf shows 9.2 Gbps between nodes, curl to s3 p95=78ms.
raj: scheduler smoke: deployed test pod with tolerations, CPU/GPU allocation respected, no pod evictions in 20m.
maria: SLO gate check: p95 inference latency=42ms, pod restart rate=0.1%, GPU util=9%, egress p95=78ms. All gates passed.
maria: Handoff approved. @oncall-rotation please take over post-handoff monitoring and remove dedicated-testing label after 48h.
oncall-rotation: acknowledged, monitoring playbook open. I'll keep 2h high-cadence checks.
maria: thanks everyone — I'll file the handoff note in confluence and attach the smoke outputs. :rocket:
